children.name:
Give active administrators a narrow governance boundary for workspace
      identity, invitation issuing, safe branding, shared-space creation
      policy, member visibility, and role assignment.
terms:
"
      Give active administrators a narrow governance boundary for workspace
      identity, invitation issuing, safe branding, shared-space creation
      policy, member visibility, and role assignment.
      "
"Require an active administrator for every governance mutation and keep ordinary self-service elsewhere."
"Central configuration and role changes affect every conversation boundary."
"Do not infer administrative authority from route namespace, record ownership, a hidden control, or automation identity."

children.name: Current workspace discovery requires current authenticated human authority and an active human member. Missing or multiple configurations are explicit failures. No submitted actor identifier establishes authority.
terms: "Current workspace discovery requires current authenticated human authority and an active human member. Missing or multiple configurations are explicit failures. No submitted actor identifier establishes authority."

children.name: There is one workspace configuration; its identifier is never user-editable.
terms: "There is one workspace configuration; its identifier is never user-editable."

children.name: Only active human administrators may execute governance mutations; agent and automation identities never administer the workspace.
terms: "Only active human administrators may execute governance mutations; agent and automation identities never administer the workspace."

children.name: Invitations expire seven days after issuance using server time; a submitted occurredAt never controls their lifetime. Invitation acceptance requires the actual new active human Member account with the matching name, consumes the live token and creates the governance member atomically; failure preserves all tokens and members.
terms: "Invitations expire seven days after issuance using server time; a submitted occurredAt never controls their lifetime. Invitation acceptance requires the actual new active human Member account with the matching name, consumes the live token and creates the governance member atomically; failure preserves all tokens and members."

children.name: Each issued invitation code identifies one live token. A successful join deletes exactly that token; a used code cannot be redeemed again because its token no longer exists.
terms: "Each issued invitation code identifies one live token. A successful join deletes exactly that token; a used code cannot be redeemed again because its token no longer exists."

children.name: Invitation tokens are disclosed only through invitation views to active administrators or inside an administrator-authorized join link; they never appear in profile, snapshot, member or audit read models.
terms: "Invitation tokens are disclosed only through invitation views to active administrators or inside an administrator-authorized join link; they never appear in profile, snapshot, member or audit read models."

children.name: Changing shared-space creation policy affects only future create attempts and neither revokes nor grants existing memberships.
terms: "Changing shared-space creation policy affects only future create attempts and neither revokes nor grants existing memberships."

children.name: The workspace must retain at least one active human administrator; role change, removal, ban, or deactivation cannot violate that invariant.
terms: "The workspace must retain at least one active human administrator; role change, removal, ban, or deactivation cannot violate that invariant."

children.name: Member directory views shown to ordinary members exclude banned and deactivated identities unless needed to attribute retained history; administrators may inspect moderation standing.
terms: "Member directory views shown to ordinary members exclude banned and deactivated identities unless needed to attribute retained history; administrators may inspect moderation standing."

children.name: A logo is a validated bounded image transformed by an adapter; deleting it restores a stock presentation without changing workspace identity.
terms: "A logo is a validated bounded image transformed by an adapter; deleting it restores a stock presentation without changing workspace identity."

children.name: Custom styling is size-bounded, sanitized, cannot load remote resources or execute script, and cannot hide security-critical controls from assistive or visual users.
terms: "Custom styling is size-bounded, sanitized, cannot load remote resources or execute script, and cannot hide security-critical controls from assistive or visual users."

children.name: Public branding assets are immutable by revision and safely cacheable; a branding change produces a new revision.
terms: "Public branding assets are immutable by revision and safely cacheable; a branding change produces a new revision."

children.name: Governance changes are auditable with actor, target, time, and change kind while secrets and credential material are excluded from audit data.
terms: "Governance changes are auditable with actor, target, time, and change kind while secrets and credential material are excluded from audit data."

children.name: Removing an agent removes every conversation participation for that agent.
terms: "Removing an agent removes every conversation participation for that agent."

children.name: Member removal deletes the directory entry, publishes MemberRemoved, and never leaves the workspace without an active human administrator.
terms: "Member removal deletes the directory entry, publishes MemberRemoved, and never leaves the workspace without an active human administrator."

children.name: A person admitted through a live invitation appears in the administration member directory with their profile name, Member role, Active standing, and non-automation flag; the directory entry commits together with the joining person and the redeemed token.
terms: "A person admitted through a live invitation appears in the administration member directory with their profile name, Member role, Active standing, and non-automation flag; the directory entry commits together with the joining person and the redeemed token."

children.name: Issuing an invitation token leaves every other token and all existing members and sessions unchanged. Issuance and join use one transactional token store; deletion is committed with creation of the joining person.
terms: "Issuing an invitation token leaves every other token and all existing members and sessions unchanged. Issuance and join use one transactional token store; deletion is committed with creation of the joining person."
